shots.detail_en: Late night lamp close-up: two sheets pressed side by side under the counter lamp — the prediction slip and a torn page from her father's ledger
shots.sub: 红（自语）："账对不上，人就一定在说谎。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: next morning Hongli stops mopping Chang Hong and slaps a stack of vouchers onto his mop handle
shots.sub: 红："帮我盘三天账。盘对了，借你西装；盘错了——你告诉我，预测单的'陆'字，最后一笔为什么抖。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Two-shot at the counter corner: Chang Hong flips ledger pages, stops his pen at three entries
shots.sub: 长："三笔挂单，同一分钟进的场。你查的不是账——是'谁'。" 红："我查的是账。账，会认人。"
shots.speaker: CH/RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong circles the three stacked orders, his pen tip landing exactly on the 'Lu' character
shots.sub: 长："字抖，是因为写字的人，握过十年前那场雨。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Montage: Chang Hong auditing / Hongli watching his hands / each holding something back from the other
shots.sub: 旁白："她要我的来历，我要她的柜台。各怀心事，账却越盘越顺。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Man Cang peeks in hugging a row of iced milk teas, then shrinks back behind the door frame to watch
shots.sub: 满："账房重地！我一个外人——就不进来了！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Hall wide: aftermath of the Xiong faction pump-and-dump, stylized — red columns on the flip board, a big player silhouette waving, scattered retail shadows
shots.sub: 散户丙（画外）："说好的三连板呢！"
shots.speaker: 散户丙

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong stares at the board, mop frozen mid-air
shots.sub: 长（低）："账上多出来的钱，一定有人少了一笔。熊家的秤，从来两头翘。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli sees through it but keeps tallying without a flinch
shots.sub: 红："你怎么知道是大户出的货？" 长："潮先于船到。父亲说的。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: after work Chang Hong folds the borrowed suit to return it; one cuff worn through
shots.sub: 红："袖口磨了，赔你十块。" 长："记我账上。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Insert, Hongli's home: she opens her father's old ledger, a yellowed clipping glued to one page reading '1993 crash, a major player dies' (unnamed, blurred)
shots.sub: 红（画外）："那年我十岁。只记得爸烧了三天账本。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: tiny handwriting at the ledger page foot — 'Brother Zhenhai's advance cleared' (first reveal of the old bond)
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Hongli grips the ledger under the lamp, her eyes shifting from teller mode back to a ten-year-old's
shots.sub: 红（轻声）："垫资……陆叔叔。你的儿子，现在在我的柜台扫K线。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Wide: next morning's opening, Chang Hong and Hongli lock eyes for an instant across the crowd, then each looks down
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Explosive mid shot: the manager barks during inspection — Hongli steps in front of Chang Hong in front of everyone
shots.sub: 经理："扫地工怎么站进大户区了？" 红："我雇他盘账。出了事，记我头上。"
shots.speaker: 经理/RED

shots.detail_en: Close two-shot: Chang Hong stunned a beat, then calm; their eyes meet sharply
shots.sub: 长（低）："账房先生，原来姓沈。" 红："账房的账，比你的K线诚实。"
shots.speaker: CH/RED

shots.detail_en: Quick cuts: the two auditing side by side (first shoulder-to-shoulder action, foreshadowing the trio)
shots.sub: 旁白："那天之后，我的单子，多了一双眼睛。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Man Cang gawks with two milk teas, popping the lid off one
shots.sub: 满："完了完了……全仓的钱，摊上账房小姐了。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Suspense close-up: at night Hongli pins Chang Hong's prediction slip deep into her drawer, one corner of the old photo pressing beside it, still not fully visible
shots.sub: 红："再对一次账。对上了，我就问你那个问题。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："什么问题？——'你父亲，是不是叫陆振海？'"
shots.card: 什么问题？——"你父亲，是不是叫陆振海？"
